title: PIXL 8000 Sakura Raspberry Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Sakura Raspberry PIXL 8000 Prefilled Pod offers a unique balance of sweet Raspberry and delicate Sakura blossom for a refined fruit-floral vape. The subtle floral note enhances the bright berry core, creating a smooth, fragrant blend that feels both distinctive and refreshing. Each pod contains 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid for smooth satisfaction and consistent vapour. Designed for use with the PIXL 8000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit, it connects to a 10ml refill reservoir that automatically refills as you vape, supporting up to 8000 puffs per kit. Mesh coil technology keeps the flavour balanced and authentic with a soft MTL inhale.
